subject: [PATCH v8 19/30] mm: free PMD swap entries in zap_huge_pmd()

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the zap_huge_pmd() function to handle PMD swap entries before attempting to access a folio. It checks if the cleared PMD is a swap entry and, if so, frees the associated swap slots and updates the memory management counters accordingly.
